description: Return a FRESH, unused Liquid receive address for this wallet (no on-chain reuse across calls). Blocked with BACKUP_REQUIRED until the seed backup is exported and confirmed (§2.9). Moves no money.

index.description: Advanced: derive a specific descriptor index. Must stay within 20 of the wallet's own frontier — further out, a rescan cannot rediscover the address and a payment to it would be invisible. Omit for a FRESH, unused receive address (recommended — the SDK guarantees no on-chain reuse across calls).
